dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: How're you feeling? Try not to worry too much about the next fight!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I've heard people say that having a good attitude actually benefits your health.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Even if spearmanship isn't my strong suit, I'll do my best to protect you in this battle!
